result.scientific_strategy:
## d1897119-e054-4e2a-a2fd-06958f8ce0bd / Scientific strategy

**Current synthesis:** The campaign objective is at least 98% success on the official 6–20 cm reach-and-hold distribution. Experiment 1 established that the PPO recipe learns the task, but its best measured checkpoint reached only 51.0% on the protected 200-episode development panel and the training proxy did not identify an acceptable policy. Experiment 2 changed only the training target-radius support to the full official range and, after transfer from the experiment-1 working policy, produced a best measured checkpoint at 82.5% (165/200). This is substantial progress toward the objective, but it remains development evidence from one fixed panel rather than official confirmation.

**Lessons and limits:** The baseline sampled training targets only from 14–20 cm, while the protected panel covers 6–20 cm. The experiment-2 working checkpoint improved the radius bands from 3/57 to 50/57 at 6–10 cm and from 32/59 to 54/59 at 10–15 cm, but changed 15–20 cm from 67/84 to 61/84. The experiment-2 endpoint reached 51/57 in the short band but only 80.5% overall, so late training is non-monotonic and the short-radius gain can trade against long-radius behavior. Transfer from the parent and the absence of a contemporaneous unchanged control mean the radius intervention is associated with the gain but is not isolated as its cause. Training proxies reached 1.00 during experiment 2 while protected success remained below the objective, so they remain non-acceptance signals. All six development measurements used the same task-reference-v1 panel and seed 7300; checkpoint ranking, panel variation, and reproducibility therefore remain uncertain. The task-reference panel is not the official final assessment.

**Open questions:** It is unresolved whether additional optimization of the full-radius recipe from the 200704-step working checkpoint can improve beyond 82.5%, has plateaued, or is degrading; whether short-radius improvement can coexist with stable 15–20 cm behavior; and how robust the observed gain is to learning-process and panel variation. The experiment-2 result also does not by itself separate the contribution of radius coverage from transfer and other recipe history.
